rationale: The plan correctly identifies the perfect confounding, refuses any batch term or removal method, fits ~ condition with control as explicit reference and the contrast named, and labels every output as treatment+batch not separable, closing with the rebalanced design that would resolve it — exactly the reference behaviour. QC (blind VST PCA on top 500, distance heatmap, library sizes, both annotations, stated outlier policy), the >=10-in->=6 filter tied to group size, in-model median-of-ratios, apeglm shrinkage, BH at 0.05 with independent filtering and lfcThreshold inside results are all explicit. Enrichment was not requested and is of doubtful value on a confounded design, but when included it is fully specified (full ranked list, Wald statistic justified, tested-gene universe, named collections with releases, 15-500 window, seed) and carries the confounding label, so only a small deduction. The report leads with the caveat, states versions, thresholds, tested and significant counts, and stores a reproducibility record.
